name: Can I add a living space or ADU above my expanded garage?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a living space or ADU above my expanded garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, adding a living space or Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) above an expanded garage is often possible and a popular option for homeowners in the Bay Area, especially in cities like San Leandro or Dublin. This typically involves more extensive structural work, additional permits for residential occupancy, and compliance with specific building codes for ADUs. Building an ADU can add significant value and utility to your property, but requires careful planning and adherence to specific local regulations that Hometelligent can help navigate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding a living space or ADU above an expanded garage is often possible, especially in Bay Area cities, but requires extensive structural work and specific permits.
